description: Write an ordered string sequence to a local file as compact JSON using json-c, subject to the recorded input and destination conditions.

interface.semantic_input: Ordered UTF-8 strings, each byte length representable by the tested signed int ABI, and a writable destination path.
interface.semantic_output: A JSON array in the named file on successful completion within the tested domain.

implementation_form: retained C++ header template, string specialization
resources: Builds an array and its serialized representation before writing. Aggregate allocation and output-size limits are uncharacterized.

preconditions.detail: Successful JSON text requires valid UTF-8 records, a representable byte length for json_object_new_string_len, and a writable destination. These are input obligations. They do not guarantee available memory or successful output.

refinements.detail: On the tested ABI INT_MAX was 2147483647. The source converts each record size to int. No boundary-sized allocation was made. A one-byte malformed input was serialized with exit zero into an invalid UTF-8 file.

postconditions.detail: On successful in-domain cases the destination contained the exact compact UTF-8 JSON array, without a final newline. Embedded NUL and control characters round-tripped.

effects.detail: Opening a destination directory or a file with a missing parent failed. Under an eight-byte file-size limit the writer reported failure and left a partial file, both when creating and when replacing the target.

invariants.detail: Order, duplicates, empty strings and embedded NUL round-tripped in the tested arrays.

formal_predicates.detail: No total correctness proof, automatic runtime guard or general discharge of input obligations.

mathematical_properties.detail: No universal encoding or inverse property was established.

state_protocol.detail: Builds a json-c array, opens a local output stream, writes and closes it synchronously.

ownership.detail: Borrows the destination and sequence. The array owns appended items; a smart pointer releases the array.

concurrency.detail: Concurrent changes and concurrent writers were not tested.

upstream_usage.detail: The pinned project's client writes a quote and an empty string and checks serialized output.

specification_question.detail: The caller supplies the destination and output format. There are no extra row parameters.
